subject.title: RFC: Org claim disputes and account recovery

question: Should ClawHub adopt a permanent public claim-dispute and self-delete recovery policy, including which outcomes are guaranteed versus handled case by case?
rationale: The current implementation establishes intake and a guarded recovery mechanism, but only maintainers can set the durable authorization, disclosure, and exception policy for ownership disputes and security-sensitive recovery.

options.title: Adopt and publish the policy
options.body: Define the public evidence and recovery contract, keep sensitive verification private, then close this RFC after the approved policy is documented.

options.title: Keep recovery case-by-case
options.body: Retain the current intake and guarded operations while documenting that recovery and disputed claims have no public eligibility guarantee yet.

options.title: Split the policy areas
options.body: Finalize namespace-claim rules now and track account-recovery guarantees in a separate security-policy decision.

recommendation.title: Adopt and publish the policy
recommendation.body: Define the public evidence and recovery contract, keep sensitive verification private, then close this RFC after the approved policy is documented.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the RFC and the merged public claim-intake work, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the policy discussion.
